_comment: MPSC's published answer key for Informatics Officer Technical Paper-II,
November 2024. Transcribed by hand from the two key PDFs on 2026-09-05.
Source PDFs (both in the recovered corpus at /home.old/, see CLAUDE.md):
Answer_Keys/Final Answer Key of Informatics Officer under ICT Department..pdf
Answer_Keys/Provisional Answer Key of Informatics Officer under ICT Department.pdf
Both are 4-page scans with no text layer; page 3 of each carries the
Technical Paper-II table. Read as rendered images, not OCR.
WHY BOTH KEYS ARE STORED. They were transcribed independently and compared.
They agree on 99 of 100 answers, which is the cross-check that this
transcription is right -- a single misread cell would have to be misread
identically in two separately-typeset documents to survive.
The one difference is Q52: provisional (C), final (Compensated). MPSC
withdrew the question and awarded it to every candidate, so the final key
gives no correct option. `final` therefore holds null for 52, NOT 'C'.
Taking the provisional answer there would ship an answer the Commission
sitting: Informatics Officer under ICT Deptt., November 2024 - Technical Paper II
